I'm also checking the rent math on Boardwalk given Park Place is mortgaged, since the double-rent rule for owning a full color set may or may not still apply.

Still, keeping the three railroads unmortgaged earns me $100 rent if p1 lands there, so it's better to hold onto them and only liquidate if I actually get squeezed. I'll end my turn as is.
